comments.author: Fontaine
comments.body_html: The issue is likely that you did not have Realism loaded last. If the content mod loads after Realism, that means the SPEAR does not exist in the database when Realism is doing its thing to weapon and ammo stats. Realism cannot modify what doesn’t yet exist in the database, so it needs to load last.
